theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_flat_convergence_cycles
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ j, BoundaryVanishes (Ts j)) → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn W < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ∃ (Rs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (Ss : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Rs j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ss j)) ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn U n), T ω - Ts j ω = (Rs j).boundary ω + Ss j ω) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => (Rs j).massOn W + (Ss j).massOn W) atTop (𝓝 0)
